zh: NetCare 数据探索：服务端自动实时解析运营商与地区部/代表处编码（直查 cs_nc_comm_customer_d_list.hq_cust_category_code / common_data_rep.dept_code），免去大表 JOIN 与反复试探列名。
历史对话检索优化：按关键词搜索默认排除当前对话，新增单轮搜索次数上限并收紧触发边界，避免 AI 无故反复翻查历史对话。
en: NetCare Data Exploration: Added real-time server-side code resolution for operator and rep-office codes via cs_nc_comm_customer_d_list.hq_cust_category_code and common_data_rep.dept_code.
Conversation History Guardrails: Keyword search now excludes the active conversation by default with a per-turn search cap and stricter trigger boundaries.
